GBR.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

_meta.title: ILO equality conventions: equal pay (C100), non-discrimination at work (C111), Indigenous and Tribal Peoples (C169)
_meta.what: Which countries have ratified each ILO convention, the date, and whether it is in force. Countries missing from the file have not ratified any of the three. value = how many of the three are in force (0-3). Absence of a convention key means not ratified.

_meta.citation: International Labour Organization, NORMLEX Information System on International Labour Standards, ratifications of C100, C111, C169 (accessed 2026-10-21).
_meta.live: No: NORMLEX blocks automated requests (Cloudflare 403) and sends no CORS header.
